name: vLLM XPU + B70 grouped_topk router patch
summary: Stock vLLM XPU image plus a native deterministic XPU grouped_topk router. Required for any context above 16384 on Arc Pro B70 with this hybrid MoE.
notes: Patch SHA-256 ea65513442e08fc427394693210fb3e2ad6c938e168a5f85b8bca3185bcad990. Two changes to vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/router/grouped_topk_router.py: (1) a device-native XPU implementation of grouped_topk (repeated argmax + one-hot masks, no CPU sync) that is deterministic in eager mode, and (2) torch.compiler.disable on the router under XPU - a deliberate graph break at the MoE router that keeps the rest of the model compiled. Applied at container start to both the site-packages and workspace copies of vLLM. Verified against vLLM 0.30.0: the anchors are unchanged since 0.26, so the same file applies without edits. Cost: about 16% decode on short contexts versus the stock path. Benefit, measured: without this patch the engine cannot boot above max-model-len 16384 on image 2c427ef4 - 131072 and 262144 both die at init inside a torch.compile MoE kernel with 'Assertion index out of bounds: 0 <= tmp0 < 128' (128 = n_routed_experts), before any KV cache is allocated. It is therefore required for long context, not only for determinism. It also restores byte-reproducible temperature-0 replay, which the stock path does not guarantee (5x identical greedy replays produced 1, 2 and 3 distinct outputs across sessions without it). Upstream: fused XPU grouped_topk was proposed as vllm-project/vllm#53580.
